research_question: Why does hierarchical 7x2 show substantially larger end-to-end Q.ANT discrepancy than the term-count model predicts?
hypothesis: The 7x2 residual is primarily caused by stronger propagation of stage-1 perturbations through the trained head rather than by the head's isolated Q.ANT approximation error.
falsification_criterion: Not supported if 7x2 does not show a reproducibly larger stage2_input_propagation_error relative to its predicted/observed residual than the comparison architectures.
limitations: Diagnostic proxy for sensitivity is not a full Jacobian analysis.
CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
